summary: Kanzhun Limited filed a Form 6-K attaching a Next Day Disclosure Return required under Hong Kong Stock Exchange rules. The return details share repurchases for cancellation on multiple dates from March to April 2026, with per-share prices ranging from approximately USD 6.57 to 7.14, representing less than 0.1% of outstanding shares each. The buybacks are conducted on-market and are part of the company's ongoing capital return program. No board recommendation, advisor, or premium is mentioned. The shares repurchased are not yet cancelled. Watch for further buyback activity and cancellation completion.
